last_evaluation.summary: The visual overhaul is judged met. All seven sub-goals were already accepted. The last open item, the boy's interact animation on game actions, now works, and the game screen fades scene changes and ignores empty or unknown scenes.

assessment.requirements: All seven sub-goals were already judged met. The remaining work was the carried-over behaviour: the boy plays his interact animation on an action, and a scene change fades, while an empty or unknown scene is ignored. That is now in the action handler and covered by passing unit tests. No placeholder room art remains in the source.
assessment.business: Players now get the pixel-art room, the framed header and story panel, in-scene object actions, and feedback when they act. They see the interact animation, and scene changes fade smoothly. Nothing visible is known to be missing.
assessment.technical: The product code compiles without errors. The chain's reported null-safety problem in the action handler is already fixed. The only type errors left are in test files, such as missing props in test fixtures, and they don't affect the shipped app. The unit tests for the new behaviour pass. The remaining risk is that I did not run the app, so the visual match to the reference rests on the earlier sub-goal verdicts.
